note: Thread-level metadata only. Contents gitignored — same reasoning as corpus/messages.csv. Generated by bin/wb-facebook-manifest; do not hand-edit, rerun the tool (dat:0052).

provenance.generation: Docs-converted copies created 2026-09-08, message files titled exactly `message_1`
provenance.method: Search pagination does not advance — it returns the newest 100 every time. Enumerated instead by walking `createdTime <` backwards in slices of 100. Every fetched file is deduplicated by sha256, so the second copy of the export contributes nothing.
provenance.verified: See kb/data/0034. All contents distinct by hash.

denominator: 16238 messages carry a timestamp, which is the archive's true count. 15923 of them carry attributable text and are searchable by bin/wb-corroborate. Of the rest, 297 have a timestamp and no text (attachments, stickers, call notices), 13 sit unheaded in threads naming more than two participants and are counted rather than guessed, and 5 are empty segments. A null result from a search is a null over the searchable 15923, not over the archive. The per-thread `messages` figures below are name-headed blocks only and undercount any thread whose counterparty the export left unnamed — see dat:0054.
